title: Merge Intervals
summary: Replace overlapping closed intervals with their union.

contractDetails.output-checking: Check the exact merged interval pairs, allowing any output order.

statement: Replace overlapping closed intervals with their union. Return the resulting disjoint intervals. Intervals sharing an endpoint overlap.

examples.explanation: The first two intervals meet at 4.
The identical singletons represent one point.
The inner interval contributes no new coverage.

hints: Conceptual: Put intervals with nearby starts next to each other.
Directional: Only the last merged interval can overlap the next start in sorted order.
Implementation: Extend the active end when an interval overlaps. Otherwise emit the active interval and start another.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space when sorting a copy.
